description: This file defines a QWidget subclass for real-time spectrogram plotting, including methods for loading WAV files, adjusting display parameters, and rendering spectrograms with matplotlib and scipy.

classes.name: Plot_spectrogram_RT
classes.description: A QWidget subclass for real-time spectrogram visualization with interactive controls.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the spectrogram plotting widget, sets up UI components and event filters.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events and forwards them to the main window.

methods.name: get_wav_info
methods.description: Reads a WAV file and extracts audio data and frame rate.

methods.name: time_interval_changed
methods.description: Adjusts the time window for spectrogram display.

methods.name: frequency_interval_changed
methods.description: Updates the display when frequency range controls are changed.

methods.name: load_wav
methods.description: Loads a WAV file and stores audio data and frame rate.

methods.name: plot_spectro
methods.description: Generates and displays a spectrogram centered on a specified time.
